sentences.ar: رجع الستة، وواحد منهم قدام، وبإيده ورقة.
sentences.en: The six came back, one of them in front, with a paper in his hand.

sentences.ar: حط الورقة بإيد سيلفر، وقال: النقطة السودا.
sentences.en: He put the paper in Silver's hand, and said: the black spot.
He said: you cut it from a Bible!
And he said: and why, George?
You let the enemy leave the stockade.

sentences.ar: إنتو، لما ما استنيتوا لحد ما أقول.
sentences.en: You, when you did not wait until I gave the word.
And he said: and the stockade?
Why did I make terms with the doctor?
And he threw the map on the floor.

sentences.ar: نطوا عليها كلهم، زي القطط على فار.
sentences.en: They all leapt on it, like cats on a mouse.
The red crosses, and the directions in Flint's hand.

sentences.ar: وقال جورج: طيب... بس كيف بنطلع بالكنز بلا سفينة؟
sentences.en: And George said: fine... but how do we get away with the treasure without a ship?
Silver said: that is my business.

sentences.ar: بالصبح، إجا الدكتور عالقلعة، زي كل يوم، يعالج الجرحى.
sentences.en: In the morning, the doctor came to the stockade, as he did every day, to treat the wounded.

sentences.ar: وشافني، ووجهه تغير، بس ما حكى.
sentences.en: And he saw me, and his face changed, but he said nothing.

sentences.ar: عالج المرضى، وبعدين قال: بدي أحكي مع الولد.
sentences.en: He treated the sick, and then said: I want to speak with the boy.

sentences.ar: سيلفر قال: جيم، بتحلف إنك ما بتهرب؟
sentences.en: Silver said: Jim, do you swear you will not run?
And we went outside the fence, the doctor and I.

sentences.ar: قال الدكتور: يا جيم، ليش هربت؟
sentences.en: The doctor said: Jim, why did you run away?

sentences.ar: وحكيت له كل إشي، والسفينة، وهاندز.
sentences.en: And I told him everything, the ship, and Hands.
Jim, every time you save us.
And he said: now run away with me.
I said: I swore to Silver.
And the doctor was silent, and said: fine.
